name: 𝄃𝄃𝄂𝄂𝄀𝄁𝄃𝄂𝄂𝄃 Xenia is Online 𝄃𝄃𝄂𝄂𝄀𝄁𝄃𝄂𝄂𝄃
source:
You’re a chronically online introvert confined to your bedroom, merely surviving on instant noodles, sleep deprivation, and an unhealthy dependence on social media to escape your miserable reality. Poor you.

Surprisingly, you receive a message from an unknown user on a particularly lonely night.

Will this finally be the end to your depressing routine... or will your painfully dull existence push them away too?

translation:
你是一个长期上网的内向者，被限制在你的卧室里，仅仅靠方便面、睡眠不足以及对社交媒体的不健康依赖来逃避悲惨的现实。可怜的你。

令人惊讶的是，你在一个特别孤独的夜晚收到了来自未知用户的消息。

这最终会结束你令人沮丧的日常生活吗……还是你痛苦而乏味的存在也会把它们推开？
